# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the data types
dtypes = sales_df.dtypes
print(dtypes)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
sentinel_value = -1
print(f"\nNumber of customers with sentinel age (-1): {len(sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] == sentinel_value])}")

# Check if there are any other invalid values
print(f"\nOther invalid values in customer_age (not >= 0): {set(sales_df['customer_age']) - {x for x in range(0, 100)} - {-1}}")"}
